As Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) Stock Value Rose, Holder Firsthand Capital Management Lowered Holding by $860,000; Mcdonalds (MCD) Holder Howard Hughes Medical Institute Has Cut Holding
May 24, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
Howard Hughes Medical Institute decreased its stake in Mcdonalds Corp (MCD) by 37.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Howard Hughes Medical Institute sold 15,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 25,000 shares of the restaurants company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.30M, down from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Howard Hughes Medical Institute who had been investing in Mcdonalds Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $126.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.36% or $2.17 during the last trading session, reaching $161.62. About 3.84 million shares traded. McDonald's Corporation (NYSE:MCD) has risen 21.62% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.07% the S&P500.
Firsthand Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) by 12.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Firsthand Capital Management Inc sold 5,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 35,000 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.04 million, down from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Firsthand Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Holding Limited for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $505.67 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.47% or $0.93 during the last trading session, reaching $196.8. About 12.81 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.

Firsthand Capital Management Inc, which manages about $369.46 million and $135.79M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5,000 shares to 9,500 shares, valued at $1.61 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Illinois Tool Works Inc. (NYSE:ITW) by 5,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 10,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Softbank Group Corp. (SFTBY).
Analysts await Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) to report earnings on August, 16. They expect $1.16 earnings per share, up 23.40% or $0.22 from last year’s $0.94 per share. BABA’s profit will be $2.98B for 42.41 P/E if the $1.16 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.54 actual earnings per share reported by Alibaba Group Holding Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 114.81% EPS growth.
